title: The Seed Swap Envelopes
story: April showers moved the library's spring seed swap indoors, and three gardeners left envelopes of saved seeds on the returns cart. Then someone opened the front door, and a draft sent every label skating under the shelves. Wren, who can recite every overdue book in town, whispers that each thank-you note must reach the right gardener. Who brought which seeds?
